title: EU data law from 1995 to now, for a founder selling into Europe
prompt: A timeline of EU data and privacy law from 1995 to now, for a startup founder who sells in Europe.
note: The archetype, kept calm: a single vertical spine in sans with mono dates to the left, three era bands that name what was true in each era rather than only its years, and the three turning points as the only toned cards, so a founder skimming sees where the ground shifted before reading an entry. The now marker splits the spine into a solid past and a dashed future with hollow dots, and the one date the research could not settle is labeled verify rather than guessed.
